claim_assessments.statement: For smooth connected compact Kahler X, effective rational SNC B with coefficients <1, and nef M in Pic(X) tensor Q, pseudo-effective K_X+B and nef K_X+B+M imply a semiample rational line representative of the real Bott-Chern class of that adjoint.
claim_assessments.fidelity: Retains connectedness, rational holomorphic lines on X, analytic nefness and real Bott-Chern equality. Allows a flat twist; does not assert actual semiampleness of the original line.

claim_assessments.statement: The ordinary analytic decomposition, algebraic-dimension-zero two-diagonal argument, rational nef descent, global flat twists and period-based ordinary adjoint construction hold.
claim_assessments.fidelity: The ordinary decomposition and period/flat-descent interfaces require actual rational-line identities. The zero-dimensional-algebraic-reduction branch proves vanishing of the nef Chern class, not original-line triviality without a flat change.

supported_scope: Faithful catalogue of the main Bott-Chern representative theorem and the named analytic dependencies, with all assigned claims resolved to v1.
Proposition 8.1 attribution matches the projective positive-part statement; the enriched rational-line model presentation also requires the fixed-nef-data generalized MMP.
Ordinary decomposition, companion log-Iitaka/period inputs and analytic model constructions remain cited or unreproduced dependencies, not accepted outside theorems.
No supporting historical judgement establishes these claims; finite-data/algebraic support and stale report flags do not constitute current independent acceptance.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Establish the actual ordinary rational-line decomposition in every dimension and its log-Iitaka hypothesis; combine projective Proposition 8.1 with a separate terminating generalized program to obtain the model identity and the full negative part.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: The old draft only cites the unlisted ordinary/period companions and projective dependency; the local Frobenius proof does not establish those theorem-level inputs.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Exclude sweeping correspondences via irregularity on fixed finite covers, establish meromorphic nonvanishing with cotangent bounds, preserve current mass and log-ideal orders through both diagonals, prove a positive rank fraction and common maximal-minor order, and turn the resulting signed divisor into vanishing of the nef class.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Algebraic rank and determinant certificates contain none of the analytic current approximation, incidence-pole, determinant-sheaf or signed-divisor constructions.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Remove singular-fiber vertical divisors using the weighted intersection matrix and negativity, recover rationality via injective rational H^2 pullback, prove nefness on the projective base and choose a global descended representative.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Numerical triviality on smooth fibers alone does not construct a rational holomorphic nef line downstairs or kill the vertical correction.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Construct countably many detecting global fibrations, fix global flat twists before the very general fiber is selected, descend an actually fiber-trivial flat line including finite meridian holonomy, and lift sections by coherent base change.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: The inductive fiberwise flat twist is not known to extend; the old draft has no global detection or quantifier-compatible choice construction.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Construct and extend the cyclic root eigenline, identify its discriminant-weighted Hodge norm, retain actual rational line descent, prove equality of extreme-line and full period ranks under real polarization, and select an effective klt boundary representing H-K_Z.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Neither a projective canonical bundle formula alone nor the Frobenius certificate supplies the nonprojective-total-space period and line-identity steps.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Preserve the fixed projective algebraic base through the augmented ordinary program, identify the entire analytic negative part over codimension-two base images, and descend the semiample representative D+F through a smooth modification.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Birational exceptional translation and numerical equality alone do not establish this positive-relative-dimension negative-part identity or the global flat representative.
